newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA FUND SHARE NET VALUE DECREASES.
newsitem.headline: HANSA FUND SHARE NET VALUE DECREASES.

text.p: Hansa Privatisation Investment Fund's third emission decreased the net value of its share from 39.20 kroons to 37.70 kroons, the company said on Wednesday.

Between March 7 and March 31, the net value of its existing shares was 39.20 kroons but when the money from the issue was received on March 31, the net value of a share decreased to 37.70 kroons, the company said in a statement.
The Fund sold 332,576 shares in its third public offer worth 11.3 million kroons at a fixed price of 34 kroons per share.
